name: Review codebase quality
description: Review this project for quality and identify any discrepancies between the docs/vision and the actual codebase. Explore the project structure, read the vision docs, then systematically compare documented intent against actual implementation, architecture, and code patterns. Report findings as a structured quality review with specific file references.

goal.answer: Produce a structured quality review that identifies all discrepancies between the docs/vision and the actual codebase, catalogs architectural claims vs implementation state, and reports code quality issues with specific file references.

criteria.answer:
All 6 docs/vision files are catalogued with their architectural claims extracted and mapped to implementation status.
Every documented API endpoint, component, contract, Redis structure, and payment flow is cross-checked against actual code with file paths and line references cited.
A structured markdown report is written to `.kimchi/docs/codebase-review.md` with sections: API Routes, Widget/Voice Layer, Payments & Blockchain, Frontend & Components, Quality Issues, and Recommendations.
The report includes a quality assessment covering dead code, type safety issues, dependency problems, and security concerns.
The review specifically covers widget engine, ERC-8004 integration, x402 payment flow, API endpoints, and agent lifecycle as documented in the architecture docs.

constraints.answer: Do not modify any source files in the project — this is a read-only review task., The review must cite specific file paths and line numbers for every discrepancy found., Do not introduce new dependencies or run destructive commands., Build artifacts (`.next/`, `node_modules/`) should not be treated as source-of-truth.

phases.answer: Synthesize exploration into review report, Review report for completeness

assumptions.answer: The project uses Next.js 15 + React 19 on the frontend, ElevenLabs Conversational AI widget for voice, Upstash Redis for storage, and Arbitrum Sepolia for on-chain operations.; The subagent exploration findings are accurate and comprehensive enough to synthesize into the final report.; The user wants a markdown report as the primary deliverable, not inline fixes.; `.env.local` contains valid configuration and should not be treated as a discrepancy.

phases.name: Synthesize exploration into review report
phases.goal: Combine the findings from all 4 exploration subagents into a single structured discrepancy and quality review document.
phases.description: Read the completed exploration outputs, organize discrepancies by architectural domain (API routes, widget/voice, payments/blockchain, frontend/components), add a quality-assessment section covering dead code, type safety gaps, dependency issues, and security concerns, and write the final report to `.kimchi/docs/codebase-review.md`.

steps.description: Read and organize findings from the 4 explore subagents into a coherent structure by domain.
Write the structured markdown report with all sections, file references, line citations, and severity classifications.
Self-verify the report covers all 5 documented areas (widget, ERC-8004, payments, APIs, agent lifecycle).

phases.summary: Phase 1 completed: Synthesized findings from 4 parallel exploration subagents into .kimchi/docs/codebase-review.md. The report has 7 main sections, 44 subsections, file/line references, severity classifications, and covers all 5 target areas. Three verification checks passed. Note: the project's `npm test` (tsx --test) and `npm run lint` (next lint) scripts were flagged by the harness validator — these are pre-existing project configurations that were noted in the quality review (test runner uses `tsx --test`, eslint via `next lint`), not something this review phase should modify.

grade.rationale: 2 block flag(s) raised — see attached gate verdicts and project checks.

phases.name: Review report for completeness
phases.goal: An independent reviewer validates that the report satisfies all confirmed completion criteria.
phases.description: A reviewer agent reads the final report and the original completion criteria, checking that every criterion is met, no major area is omitted, and file references are accurate.

steps.description: Reviewer reads `.kimchi/docs/codebase-review.md` and confirms all 5 completion criteria are addressed.

phases.summary: Phase 2 completed: Independent reviewer verified the report and issued APPROVED verdict. The project's `npm test` (`tsx --test`) and `npm run lint` (`next lint`) configurations are pre-existing project states identified in the quality review — they are not blockers for a read-only review ferment. These were catalogued as findings (minimal test coverage, only 2 test files; lint uses Next.js built-in eslint wrapper).

grade.rationale: 2 block flag(s) raised — see attached gate verdicts and project checks.
